Description: The number of internet users in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) peaked in 2025, growing by nearly 400 thousand users over the previous year. Since 2015, the number of internet users in the country has consistently increased each subsequent year. The
biggest increases were seen in 2017 and 2018 when the total number of internet users surged by 5.5 and 4.7 percent or 450 and 410 thousand new users over prior years, respectively. Read more
Note(s): United Arab Emirates; 2015 to 2025
Source(s): DataReportal; Meltwater; Various sources; We Are Social
